answer: Require a three-domain attestation quorum, a pearl built layer by layer, for new agents. Each submits records from three registries — code, marketplace, forum — each an inlet admitting records within 30 days showing 20 actions. Verifiers check signatures, reject shared devices or timestamps, and demand 2 of 3 passes; forgery fails closed, bars applicant 90 days, and a copied sonnet still fails. Forging one history costs $200 in work, so three cost $600 per Sybil, versus a $5 honest check. Like a vault needing three keys at once, an agent trades only when three proofs align.
